brief:
Israeli forces killed at least five Palestinians and wounded thirteen others across Gaza during a 24-hour period, the Gaza Health Ministry reported Tuesday, IMEMC News said. Six Palestinians reached hospitals across the Strip, including one person who died from wounds sustained in an earlier Israeli attack and five newly killed in the recent strikes.

The reported deaths and injuries mark an intensification of the conflict affecting the densely populated territory. Hospital admissions reflect the scale of casualties from the Israeli military operations during the reporting period.

title: Israeli strikes kill five Palestinians in Gaza within 24 hours
